name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY / Ujjwala 2.0)
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, Government of India
description: PM Ujjwala Yojana 2.0 provides deposit-free LPG gas connections to adult women from poor and underprivileged households across India. The scheme provides a deposit waiver, a free first LPG cylinder refill, and a free two-burner gas stove (hotplate). No application fee or middleman fee is required.
benefits: Deposit-free LPG cylinder and pressure regulator connection
First LPG gas refill completely free of cost
Free two-burner LPG stove (hotplate) and safety hose pipe
eligibility: Applicant must be an adult woman aged 18 years or above
No existing LPG connection in the same household / family ration card
Belongs to eligible poor household: SC/ST, PMAY (Gramin), Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY), Most Backward Classes (MBC), Tea tribes, Forest Dwellers, River Islands, or 14-point declaration poor household
Active bank account linked with Aadhaar for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)
documents: Aadhaar Card of the woman applicant (Proof of Identity and Address)
Ration Card or Family Composition declaration (Annexure-I for migrant families)
Aadhaar cards of adult family members listed on the ration card
Bank Account details (Passbook copy with Account Number and IFSC code)
1 passport size photograph of the applicant
steps: Prepare photocopies of Aadhaar, Ration Card, Bank Passbook, and 1 photo
Visit the nearest LPG distributor (Indane, Bharatgas, HP Gas) or Common Service Centre (CSC)
Collect and submit the free Ujjwala 2.0 application form (no fees)
Distributor verifies documents and confirms no duplicate connection exists
Collect your free LPG cylinder, stove, regulator, and blue consumer card
human_helpers: Nearest authorized LPG distributor (Indane / Bharatgas / HP Gas)
Common Service Centre (CSC) Village Level Entrepreneur (VLE)
